title: He Married I'm Not Hungry
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Love is not perfect food honesty; it is knowing the person who says they are not hungry, waiting for the best bite to prove otherwise, and ordering extra without making them confess.
emotional_arc: not-hungry anti-ideal -> Aachu's one-bite denial -> best-bite proof -> Zuv quietly orders extra -> knows-your-order thesis
source_story_summary: Aachu says she is not hungry before food arrives. Then she takes one bite from Zuv's plate, then the best bite, then somehow half the plate is hers. Zuv does not tease her in a mean way or make her ask. He learns the pattern and quietly orders extra now. The relationship truth is that love does not keep a perfect plate score; love knows your order anyway.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in a soft hand-drawn flat vector / desi storybook illustration style matching the supplied reference carousel examples. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but with the richer model-native handwritten text, faces, outfits, and brandmark composition shown in the style references. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles and creator shareability feedback.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner is deliberately partner-tag first: the hook names a universal couple behavior, Aachu's proof is the not-hungry to best-bite switch, Zuv's role is active knowing care, and the final line is sendable without private context.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: universal anti-ideal -> expressive Aachu proof -> Zuv's calm active care -> tender acceptance thesis, while using food as a behavioral receipt.

candidates.name: He Married I'm Not Hungry
candidates.universal_truth: Some people say they do not want food, then become very committed to the best bite.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's not-hungry face lasts exactly until Zuv's plate arrives.
candidates.concrete_proof: One bite, then the best bite, then half the plate quietly becoming hers.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv does not tease her into admitting it; he orders extra like he already knows the ending.

candidates.name: Bas Ek Bite
candidates.universal_truth: Bas ek bite is rarely one bite in love.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu says the smallest possible request with the most obvious food-interest face.
candidates.concrete_proof: The fork travels from one polite bite to the best part of Zuv's plate.
candidates.zuv_role: He slides the plate closer without making her perform the whole confession.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love leaves room on the plate.

candidates.name: The Extra Plate
candidates.universal_truth: The right person starts ordering for the version of you that will be hungry in five minutes.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's no-thank-you softens the moment the food appears.
candidates.concrete_proof: Two plates on the table even though only one person claimed hunger.
candidates.zuv_role: He quietly creates abundance before she has to reverse her answer.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love makes space for the maybe.

candidates.name: Not Hungry Until Yours Arrives
candidates.universal_truth: Some people are not hungry until your plate looks better than their decision.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's denial becomes mischief as soon as Zuv starts eating.
candidates.concrete_proof: Her fork entering the frame while his hand pauses mid-bite.
candidates.zuv_role: He laughs softly and lets the bite become a ritual instead of a fight.

candidates.name: Plate Scorekeeping
candidates.universal_truth: Food math is not real math when love is involved.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu insists it was only one bite with deeply unconvincing innocence.
candidates.concrete_proof: The plate has visibly changed sides while the couple is still pretending it did not.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv lets the joke stay affectionate, not prosecutorial.
